profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas. It describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations that make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

The organization describes several service lines. AI red teaming is presented as a semi-structured testing approach for assessing and improving the safety and effectiveness of AI models and systems by identifying vulnerabilities and limitations, offered as a paid service using its own software, which it says was released under an open source license in September 2026. AI contextual evaluations are described as mixed-method, bespoke evaluations of a model or system's performance for a specified problem space, with ontology-based contextual AI evaluations (OB-CAIE) in development in 2026 and also sold as a paid service. Bias bounties are described as collaboratively designed challenge sets bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts; the company says its final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025 and that it launched its first bias bounty on Zindi, a global data science challenge platform, in August 2026. A web application built for data collection at hosted red teaming events and contextual evaluations was released as open source in September 2026, with new client-facing software stated as available in October 2026. The site directs inquiries to info [at] humane-intelligence [dot] org or a contact form.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no cases. It carries a Texas law exposure count of 125.
